checks: The eight exterior null caps force the coordinate box. Total volume and the four cumulative untilted slab readings give three slabs of volume 3π on each axis. The three-slab parent applies to each axis in ambient dimension four.

The (t,s) projection of the first prism is a parallelogram with constant positive vertical sections. Nonzero cross-shear makes its lowest horizontal section a singleton, contradicting the second prism's positive constant horizontal width, including the endpoint. The second cross-shear then vanishes from its invariant [0,3] projection. Commuting pure-height translations produces K with area π.

The eight tilted levels are strictly unclipped because the cap margin at j and j+1 has opposite sign for |x_i|≤1. The shear denominator is positive since |v_i|≤2/3. Integrating yields m_i+3w_i/2=−b v_i at b=1/2 and 3/2, and the symmetric s equations force both shears and the centroid to be zero.

The corner area is (1/2+x_i/10)^2/2. Polar integration gives disk coordinate moment π/4 and the corner mass π(1/8+1/800)=101π/800. Equal area makes the radial-moment subtraction two nonnegative integrals, strictly positive if the bodies differ in positive area. Convexity and an interior ball promote almost-everywhere equality to equality.

The count is 8+4+8+2=22. The disk is the planar projection, so a polytope cannot realize the data. A containing cap t≤4 encodes total volume after confinement, and arrangement walls are Lebesgue-null.
